overview.duration: 3 h 20 min · 180 questions (45 physics, 45 chemistry, 90 biology)

overview.notes: Computer-based test held in two sessions per year (January and April); a candidate’s best session score counts. Syllabus follows the NTA-reduced syllabus in force since the 2024 cycle (2026 official syllabus PDF verified) — chapters dropped in the reduction (States of Matter, Hydrogen, s-Block, Polymers, Chemistry in Everyday Life, Communication Systems etc.) are not tested. Paper 2 Drawing portion is pen-and-paper.

overview.conductor: West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)
overview.level: Class 11-12 → undergraduate admission to Engineering/Technology, Pharmacy and Architecture courses in West Bengal
stages: Single-day written examination — Paper-I and Paper-II on the same day
papers: Paper-I Mathematics: 75 MCQs in 2 hours (11:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m.) — 50 Category-1 (1 mark each), 15 Category-2 (2 marks each), 10 Category-3 (2 marks each) = 100 marks
Paper-II Physics & Chemistry: 40 Physics + 40 Chemistry MCQs in 2 hours (2:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m.) — per subject 30 Category-1 (1 mark), 5 Category-2 (2 marks), 5 Category-3 (2 marks) = 50 + 50 marks
overview.duration: Paper-I 2 h · Paper-II 2 h (both papers on one day)
overview.marking: 200 marks total (Mathematics 100, Physics 50, Chemistry 50). Category-1: one option correct, +1 / −¼. Category-2: one option correct, +2 / −½. Category-3: one or more options correct, +2 only when all correct and none incorrect (partial credit: 1 of 2 for two of three correct in a 3-correct question), no negative marking
overview.negativeMarking: Category-1: −¼ per wrong answer · Category-2: −½ per wrong answer · Category-3: no negative marking (but any marked incorrect option voids the question)
questionTypes: Multiple-choice questions with four options per question, OMR answer sheets
Category-3 questions may have more than one correct option
overview.notes: Two merit lists from one sitting: the General Merit Rank (GMR) for engineering/technology/pharmacy/architecture and the Pharmacy Merit Rank (PMR) — candidates sitting only Paper-II are eligible for the PMR only, and Paper-I alone draws no rank. Tie-breaking walks through subject-wise negative marks and 2-mark question scores in bulletin-defined order. Counselling runs through the WBJEEB e-counselling (Kolkata centre-based option entry). For B.Arch, the NATA score is used alongside. The syllabus below is the official Appendix-9 chapter list of the WBJEE-2026 bulletin, read in full.

overview.conductor: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China with provincial examination authorities
overview.level: Senior-secondary students seeking undergraduate admission to Chinese universities
stages: One national sitting per year (7-9 June, some provinces to 10 June)
Most provinces use the 3+1+2 model: 3 unified subjects + 1 preferred (Physics or History) + 2 electives (grade-converted)
Some provinces retain the 3+3 model with three electives chosen from six
papers: Foreign Language — usually English, with listening (120 min, 150 points)
Preferred subject: Physics or History (75-90 min, 100 points)
Two electives: Chemistry, Biology, Politics, Geography (75 min each, 100 points each, grade-converted)
overview.duration: Two to four exam days per province; each subject sits separately
overview.marking: Total 750 points: unified subjects marked directly; electives grade-converted within the province
questionTypes: Constructed response (mathematics, sciences, history, politics, geography)
overview.notes: The exam assesses the national senior-secondary curriculum standards (2017 edition, 2020 revision). Mathematics offers a non-calculus track in provinces using the old liberal-arts/science split, but the current curriculum is unified with elective modules. Foreign Language candidates may sit English, Russian, Japanese, French, German or Spanish — English is by far the most common. Provincial papers (Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin) differ in format but share the national syllabus scope.
